paperInfo.copyrightNote: Original practice questions synthesized from syllabus themes and recurring ZIMSEC-style patterns; not verbatim reproduction of past papers.
paperInfo.sourceBasis: ZIMSEC O-Level Combined Science 4003/03 official paper listing and practical/investigation themes.

questions.questionText: Which safety practice is appropriate when heating a test tube?
questions.explanation: Pointing the test tube away reduces risk from splashes or sudden release.

questions.questionText: A fuse protects a circuit by

options.text: Melting when current becomes too large

questions.explanation: A fuse melts and breaks the circuit when current is excessive.

questions.questionText: Which gas is most abundant in Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up most of Earth's atmosphere.

questions.questionText: Which process in plants transports water mainly through xylem?
questions.explanation: Water moves through xylem as part of the transpiration stream.

questions.questionText: Which instrument measures temperature?
questions.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature.

questions.questionText: A metal that reacts readily with dilute acid often produces
questions.explanation: Reactive metals can displace hydrogen from dilute acids.

questions.questionText: Which component is needed for a complete simple circuit?

options.text: Only a switch with no source

questions.explanation: A complete conducting path allows current to flow from the source and back.

questions.questionText: Which environmental problem is strongly associated with excess greenhouse gases?
questions.explanation: Increased greenhouse gases can enhance the greenhouse effect and warming.

questions.questionText: Which reproductive cell is produced by the male human reproductive system?
questions.explanation: Sperm are male gametes.
